## Checklist

- [ ] The template is in `<Letter>/<Game>/` and named `<game>-<collection>.gitemplate.json`.
- [ ] It imports into Game Item Tracker without validation errors.
- [ ] The template's *Source / attribution* field names the source and its URL.
- [ ] For an update: `templateId` is unchanged and `version` is raised.
